paper.title: NavGPT: Explicit Reasoning in Vision-and-Language Navigation with Large Language Models
paper.central_claim: NavGPT demonstrates that an explicitly reasoning LLM can perform training-free vision-and-language navigation by translating visual observations and navigation history to language, exposing high-level planning, commonsense reasoning and error recovery abilities.

signatures.object: Visual/geometry/history serialization for frozen LLM navigation
signatures.information: 24views=8 headings×3 elevations at45°; BLIP2 captions, FasterRCNN classes, simulator object-center depth, relative headings, graph-provided navigable viewpoints and instruction. GPT3.5 summarizes history; GPT4 navigates main evaluation.
signatures.operation: Translate images/geometry to language; prompt manager packages current observations, reachable candidates and summarized prior route; model reasons and selects viewpoint or stop.
signatures.output: Discrete next-viewpoint navigation action or termination, not raw motor command.
signatures.conditions: Captions retain landmarks, reliable object detector and privileged graph/depth; history summary preserves instruction-relevant facts.
signatures.feedback: New viewpoint descriptions and updated history; traces illustrate reasoning, not causal faithfulness proof.
signatures.selection_rule: not_applicable: fixed harness; no persistent skill/harness admission or model training.
signatures.selection_data: Main783 val-unseen trajectories; separate216-sample ablation includes training/val-unseen environments; no independently audited development holdout.
signatures.persistence: Within-episode summarized route only; no cross-episode learned library.
signatures.failure_boundary: Caption omissions, summary loss and premature stopping; graph-restricted action/depth, not continuous physical navigation.

signatures.information: Variable FoV/view counts; captions plus detected object orientations/depth within3m.
signatures.operation: Change view granularity and cumulatively add object and depth descriptions.
signatures.output: Language observations for GPT3.5 ablation planner.
signatures.conditions: Depth calibrated by simulator; stronger main-model response not automatically same.
signatures.feedback: R2R metrics on216 instructions, no repeated stochastic run uncertainty.
signatures.selection_rule: not_applicable: authors choose interface variants, not autonomous improvement.
signatures.selection_data: Same216-sample ablation supports parameter selection; not an independent post-selection holdout.
signatures.later_use: Main pipeline; main-vs-ablation model/split difference limits inference.
signatures.claimed_effect: Intermediate granularity and grounding improve navigation.
signatures.failure_boundary: Cumulative additions cannot isolate every interaction; no raw-image same-model baseline isolates language serialization itself.

gap.author_gap: End-to-end trained VLN hides explicit higher-level planning; LLMs need a compatible visual/history/action interface.
gap.checked_gap: Language serialization lets frozen LLM act without VLN-specific training; it does not show superiority to trained specialists or prove internal reasoning fidelity.

gap.remaining_gap: Same-model causal interface comparison, robust perception/stop, physical depth and actual costs.
